source.notes: The award's own official page states no calendar date at all; it delegates the closing date to the NTU admission application closing date 'for that qualification'. I fetched the official NTU Important dates page (https://www.ntu.edu.sg/admissions/undergraduate/important-dates) and it publishes four DIFFERENT scholarship application closing dates depending on the applicant's qualification route: Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' Levels 'by 19 March 2027'; Diploma awarded by a Polytechnic 'by 21 February 2027'; International Baccalaureate 'by 19 March 2027'; NUS High School Diploma 'by 20 January 2027'. Because the single record cannot hold one of these without inventing which qualification applies, no date is written. This is a multi-route scheme, not a source conflict. I did not pick the earliest, latest, or any other date.

source.notes: This is the one record in the shard where the official page states an explicit calendar window: 1 July to 31 July 2026, i.e. a closing date of 31 July 2026 for AY26-27. records.title: Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Promotionsförderung für Ausländer:innen (FES doctoral scholarship for international doctoral candidates)
records.deadline_display: Der richtige Zeitpunkt für die Bewerbung: bis circa zwei Jahre vor Abgabe der Dissertation. Der beste Zeitpunkt für eine Bewerbung ist deswegen so früh wie möglich.

source.raw_extract: Der richtige Zeitpunkt für die Bewerbung - bis circa zwei Jahre vor Abgabe der Dissertation. Wir wünschen uns, dass unsere Stipendiat:innen so lange wie möglich von einem Stipendium profitieren. Der beste Zeitpunkt für eine Bewerbung ist deswegen so früh wie möglich.
source.exact_deadline_wording: bis circa zwei Jahre vor Abgabe der Dissertation
source.notes: The provider publishes no calendar closing date for this programme. Its only timing rule is relative to the applicant's own dissertation submission ('bis circa zwei Jahre vor Abgabe der Dissertation') and it explicitly instructs applicants to apply as early as possible; the online application form for Promotionsförderung für Ausländer:innen is published and open. The companion official application page (https://www.fes.de/studienfoerderung/bewerbung, fetched) states: 'Der richtige Zeitpunkt für die Bewerbung - Wir wünschen uns, dass unsere Stipendiat:innen so lange wie möglich von einem Stipendium profitieren. Der beste Zeitpunkt für eine Bewerbung ist deswegen so früh wie möglich. Die Fristen finden Sie bei dem von Ihnen gewählten Stipendienprogramm.' That is the provider pointing back to this programme page for the deadlines, and this page carries no date. Classified ROLLING rather than UNKNOWN because the provider publishes no closing date and directs continuous early application; confidence is MEDIUM because the provider never uses the word 'rolling' and gives only a relative timing boundary. No calendar date was invented from this.

records.title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships (ESKAS)
records.deadline_display: Applications are open starting August 20, 2026. Information on application deadlines and scholarship available by country of origin will be published here in August 2026.

source.publisher: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI) / Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS / ESKAS), Switzerland
source.raw_extract: Applying for a Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship. Information on application deadlines and scholarship available by country of origin will be published here in August 2026. Interested? Applications are open starting August 20, 2026. ... After applying - Selection: Applications are submitted to Swiss diplomatic representations. ... Awards: By the end of May at the latest, the FCS will announce its decisions regarding the scholarship awards for the following academic year. Outlook: Scholarships for the 2028-2029 academic year will be advertised online from August 2027.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Information on application deadlines and scholarship available by country of origin will be published here in August 2026.
source.notes: The only explicit calendar date on the official page is the OPENING date, 20 August 2026 - an opening date is not a deadline and was not written. The official 'at a glance' page (https://www.sbfi.admin.ch/en/swiss-government-excellence-scholarships-at-a-glance, fetched) confirms the deadline is country-specific rather than scheme-wide: 'Important: Before starting the online application, please check the available scholarship types and deadlines for your country of origin.' followed by seven per-region country/territory PDFs. The official FAQ page (https://www.sbfi.admin.ch/en/faq-swiss-government-excellence-scholarships, fetched) contains no deadline date at all. Because the closing deadline differs for each of 183 countries of origin and is set with the applicant's Swiss diplomatic representation, there is no single date for this record. I did not take the opening date as the deadline, did not infer a month range, and did not use the August 2027 re-advertising date.
